propositions: GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext via query-string parameter (?token=) in uvicorn access logs before 66af deployment
66af fix (TokenRedactingFilter, X-Rebar-Token header sourcing) is merged to main but not deployed to prod box i-00880b2c7f13527c5
Rotating the token before deploying 66af will cause the new token to be immediately re-leaked in plaintext logs on next webhook call

GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN is a shared secret used simultaneously for Gerrit HTTP basic-auth (outbound), inbound webhook validation, and container environment variable, requiring coordinated rotation via service-user.sh to avoid desync

Rotation must follow deployment of 66af and include: new token set as bot's Gerrit password, SSM parameter update, webhooks.config push to refs/meta/config, and container restart with end-to-end verification
